text: {"casual": "Rory Gallen nearly scored for Harbour Athletic with a big shot that got blocked, showing how much they wanted to take control around the 30-minute mark.", "analyst": "At 30 minutes, Rory Gallen's shot was blocked despite Harbour Athletic maintaining an 87% passing accuracy over the last 15 minutes; pressures in the attacking half doubled to 0.6 per minute but team momentum dropped from 92 to 74, highlighting a shift from control to a contested state with an xG of 0.47.", "player": "I saw Rory Gallen taking 23 passes with 87% accuracy and trying two shots, including the one that was blocked at 30 minutes—shows the pressure was on.", "es": "Rory Gallen casi anota para Harbour Athletic con un disparo bloqueado, demostrando el esfuerzo del equipo por controlar el juego a los 30 minutos."}
